name: Paterna del Campo (Spain)
description: Three horizontal stripes of red, black and blue in the proportions 3:1:2, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Paterna del Campo (a tree on red above blue).
history: Municipal flag of Paterna del Campo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Paterna del Campo arms — tree on red above blue
